Name: (AT) Unicorns by NIghtshadowCat
Author: Beanene
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17412]Unicorns[/url][b] was made by [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/184894890]NightshadowCat[/url][b] (Which they used [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17245]GreenJellyBlob's Green's Redesigned horse[/url][b]).[/b]

[u]My first ever mod!!![/u] A simple Alternative Textures Conversion of my favorite horse retexture.

[quote][b]This mod requires [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246][u]Alternative Textures[/u][/url] and also [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][u]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/u][/url] to support Alternative Textures.[/b][/quote][size=4][code]﻿How to use:
[/code][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Download my mod[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract it wherever you'd like (preferably someplace easier to access to)[/size]
[*][size=3]Copy/Paste the extracted folder to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]game's mods folder[/url]﻿. (link's for finding your game folder and mods folder).[/size]
[*]Once in-game, use the "scissors" (Incase you don't have it, you can buy it at Robin's shop) by equipping and left-clicking on the horse.
[/list]
﻿[b]﻿If there's any bugs, please let me know![/b]
